tagline: Self-playing drum pattern generator with five synthesized voices
description: Generates a one-bar, 16-step drum pattern in one of seven styles and plays it with built-in synthesized drums, looped in time with the host transport. It ignores incoming MIDI and outputs no MIDI; Export MIDI saves the pattern as a .mid file. Settings are not saved with the project.

features.name: Seven Styles
features.description: Rock, Hip-Hop, Jazz, EDM, Funk, Latin and Blues patterns, with Complexity 1-10 adding ghost notes and extra hits.

features.name: Five Drum Voices
features.description: Kick (sine sweeping 150 to 50 Hz), snare (200 Hz tone plus noise), tom (120 to 100 Hz), and hi-hat and crash as unfiltered noise bursts with short and long decays.

features.name: Swing and Fills
features.description: Swing only affects the Jazz style, adding off-beat hats above 0.3 rather than shifting timing; Fills only affect Rock, adding a four-step tom run.

features.name: Transport Sync
features.description: Steps follow the host's beat position, with each hit starting at the beginning of the host's audio block.

features.name: MIDI Export
features.description: Writes the pattern on channel 10 with General MIDI notes (36, 38, 42, 47, 49).
